subject.title: 飞书消息回复引用(replyTo)有时不显示 - OpenClaw 2026.3.23-2

question: Should maintainers repair the existing Feishu anchor PR or replace it with a narrower explicit-`replyTo` fix for this issue?
rationale: The source-backed bug remains, but a proof-positive overlapping PR is already open with conflicts and routing blockers, so starting another independent fix PR risks duplicate Feishu routing changes.

options.title: Repair the overlapping PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 as the landing vehicle after resolving conflicts and preserving current normal-group and P2P quote invariants.

options.title: Open a smaller replacement
options.body: Close or pause the broad branch and land only the explicit ordinary-send `replyTo` mapping with focused Feishu channel/outbound tests.

options.title: Split remaining symptoms
options.body: Keep this issue for explicit `replyTo` forwarding and leave zero-reply final-delivery symptoms to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91669.

recommendation.title: Repair the overlapping PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 as the landing vehicle after resolving conflicts and preserving current normal-group and P2P quote invariants.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Feishu action/media/card work touched the exact send-action and outbound surfaces involved in this decision.
